data.node_description:
E2E GDC.A30-16.90GB Instances

E2E GDC.A30-16.90GB instances are the next generation Ampere GPU instances, they are designed for AI and data science-intensive workloads.

GPU Details

This instance contains a single NVIDIA A30 Tensor Cores GPU card each with 24GB GPU memory having a memory bandwidth of 933GB/s and it has 3584 CUDA Cores and 224 Tensor Cores.

E2E GPU Image

This is an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit image and it includes NVIDIA GPU driver and CUDA toolkit pre-installed for rapid onboarding. It also bundles tools to deploy NVIDIA GPU Cloud (NGC) containers in 1 click.

Software Versions Pre-installed

  • NVIDIA Driver: 550.90.07v
  • CUDA: 11.8.89v
  • cuDNN: 8.9.5v
  • Python: 3.10.12v
  • Docker: 27.1.2v
  • NGC (NVIDIA GPU Cloud) CLI: 3.30.1v

Use Cases

A30 powers numerous application areas including HPC, genomics, 5G, rendering, deep learning, data analytics, data science, and robotics.

Documentation & Resources

  • E2E GPU cloud’s documentation
  • Guide to using the NVIDIA GPU Cloud on the E2E Cloud
  • Detailed overview of the NGC registry

This instance contains a single NVIDIA A30 Tensor Cores GPU card each with 24GB GPU memory having a memory bandwidth of 933GB/s and it has 3584 CUDA Cores and 224 Tensor Cores.

Use Cases

A30 powers numerous application areas including HPC, genomics, 5G, rendering, deep learning, data analytics, data science, and robotics.

Documentation & Resources

  • Guide to using the NVIDIA GPU Cloud on the E2E Cloud
